supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceLearningGoals: Tell and write time to the nearest minute.
teachingSteps: Identify the hour hand and its position between hours.
Count the minute marks accurately around the clock.
Write hours and minutes and verify the hands agree.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.caution: Hour and minute hands must both agree with the claimed time.
